scripts.dev: pnpm run check:services && concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm run dev:api"
scripts.dev:api: pnpm run check:services && cd services/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: pnpm run check:services && cd services/api && uv run celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker --loglevel=info
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run lint:api
scripts.lint:api: cd services/api && uv run ruff check .
